newsitem.title: USA: Stant to buy Witco grease gun unit.
newsitem.headline: Stant to buy Witco grease gun unit.

text.p: Stant Corp said on Monday it has agreed to purchase Witco Corp's Lubrimatic grease gun and related equipment manufacturing division.
Terms were not disclosed, but Stant said it expected the purchase to positively impact 1997 earnings.

The purchase also includes the right to market Lubrimatic grease and oils for automotive, recreational, hardware, lawn, garden and marine applications, Stant said, adding that it expected the acquisition to close before the end of the year.
Stant is a manufacturer of parts and systems for the original equipment and replacement automotive, heavy duty and industrial markets.
Witco also said Monday it has signed a contract with Exxon Corp's Exxon Co, U.S.A., unit to sell for an undisclosed amount of cash Witco's Southwest Petro-Chem Inc.'s grease business unit.

"The divestment of these two business units of the Lubricants Group follows the announced sale of the Kendall/Amalie unit in August," Witco chief executive Gary Cook said in a news release. "We expect to sell the remainder of the Lubricants Group by year end and concentrate our strengths on manufacturing and marketing specialty chemical products worldwide."
